title: Document Passage Explorer
description: A local Document Passage Explorer workbench with a runnable initial core and a staged improvement roadmap.

steps.goal: Add word counts per record to Document Passage Explorer, using the domain fields passage, position, and document. Preserve existing behavior and return deterministic results for empty data.
